block.createkineticlift.control_chair.to: When seated a _GUI will appear on your screen_ that gives you _information_.
You will sit on the chair and then your _keyboard/joystick_ will connect to the chairs sidestick, and lets you _control the plane_.
The chair will change into a _co-pilot_ variant.
block.createkineticlift.turbofan_front.t: Creates thrust up to _185 BPS_, and it's more efficient _20mB/s_.
For assembly you need to put _exhaust_ to make it work.
Connect it with _control chair_ to work.
item.createkinetilicft.headphones.toolti: Connect the chair with Computer Cable.
R-Click the chair, and you have main _input_. R-Click other blocks, and you have an _output_!
